messages:
mia_pm: Quick ask from Acme: they want an EU-only low-latency model behind a flag with an automated fallback hedge. Need canary plan, A/B cost checks, and a compact ops runbook.

dev_ops: Capacity note: eu pools are tight week of Nov 18. We can reserve 2 GPUs for 48h and rely on burst routing. Need an ops-exposed kill switch and an audit log for any auto-hedge decisions.

tom_eng: Suggested rollout: mandatory preflight mirror 6h for cache warmup, then canary slabs 4% (8h) -> 25% (24h) -> 75% (48h) -> 100% (7d). Each slab gated on latency+quality. Use region routing + tenant allowlist.

rachel_ml: Quality gates: mirrored eval hourly. Targets: pass_rate >= 95% on Acme prompt set, hallucination_delta < 1%, semantic-divergence < 1.2%. I'll supply a 120-prompt set focusing on long contexts and instruction-following.

leo_sre: SRE gates: p95 <= baseline + 35ms (sustained 20m -> alarm), error_rate <= baseline * 2. Circuit-breaker: 3x errors or sustained p95 > baseline + 100ms for 10m -> auto-flip kill. If gpu_util > 83% trigger hedging to quantized-q4 for 30% of new canary sessions. Page #eng-oncall.

tom_eng: Cost A/B: route 15% of canary traffic to quantized variant mirrored for evaluation. Stop cost test if quality divergence > 2% after 24h or savings < 10%. Log all shifts.

mia_pm: Draft flag schema for ops/devex: ``flag: acme_eu_hedge_v1; allowlist: ["acme_corp"]; preflight_hours: 6; canary: [{pct:4,dur:8h},{pct:25,dur:24h},{pct:75,dur:48h},{pct:100,dur:7d}]; hedging: {auto_when_gpu_util:83,shift_pct:30,target:quantized-q4}; circuit_breaker: {errors:3x, sustained_p95:+100ms}; reporting: [latency_p50,latency_p95,error_rate,quality_pass,cost_per_1k]}

dev_ops: I'll reserve the pool and add cache-warmup tasks. leo, please add the runbook snippet for paging and rollback steps.

leo_sre: Runbook short: 1) Flip kill switch; 2) Set hedging policy to 100% quantized for affected tenant; 3) Notify CSM + #eng-oncall; 4) If issue persists >30m, open rollback PR and postmortem template.

mia_pm: Owners: tom (eng), dev_ops (ops), rachel (quality), leo (sre). Action items: tom PR with flag+routing+telemetry (ETA 48h), dev_ops reserve pool, rachel publish eval set by EOD. We'll reconvene after preflight snapshots. :thumbsup:
